diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts because the lone decision-maker set the maximum refrigerated temperature to 40°F, which is lower than the 41°F specified in PF1. This is a common cautious default value that does not require any specific hidden information.

C3.why: The health guidance changes the maximum refrigerated temperature to exactly 41 degrees, the logging interval to exactly 2 hours, allergen labeling from the standard procedure to required sealed-package labels, and adds the food-safety implementation commitment.
